readerCopy.body: The fastest speaker in a conversation is not automatically the person with the most important information. When Mercury opposes Chiron, communication and sensitivity face each other directly, allowing fluency to collect on one side while lived experience makes another person slower or more careful. Speed can start looking like authority and hesitation like uncertainty. The missing context has a better chance to enter the decision when the conversation leaves enough room for the person carrying it to finish the thought.
